data_sampling: uniform train transitions, fresh teacher noise each update; fixed dev batches and noise
observation_normalization: per-feature shared-agent train mean/std with std floor .01; train only
action_normalization: none beyond teacher native physical output
action_frame: global teacher native physical action -> per-agent radial/tangential local target; local student output -> world at deployment
checkpoint_selection: minimum mean fixed dev distillation MSE, earliest step on exact ties; no closed-loop selection
pilot_selection: first 16 nonduplicates against all DB state_uid/content/physical signatures and round28 reserved pilot/eval ranges; no outcomes
precision: jax_enable_x64=False after all imports; native numpy geometry float64
noise_frame: global teacher trace_fn(obs,key)[0] -> per-agent radial/tangential local noise; deployment independent local normal fold_in(key_for(state,seed,step),i)
only_training_semantic_change: target and noise coordinates; no changed hyperparameters, sampling or checkpoint selection
